text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Thursday:
At Chelmsford: Essex 237 (A.Grayson 76, S.Law 63; N.Killeen 4-50, S. Brown 4-54). Durham 236-5 (P.Collingwood 62).
At Southampton: Hampshire 285 (K.James 56 not out; A.Mullally 4-69). Leicestershire 326-9 (D.Millns 101 not out, A.Habib 77; S.Udal 4-120).
At Old Trafford: Lancashire 125 (J.Crawley 51 not out; K.Evans 6-40) and 133-1 (J. Crawley 64 not out). Nottinghamshire 263 (U.Afzaal 70 not out, P.Johnson 66; I.Austin 4-44).
At Lord's: Middlesex 146 (P.DeFreitas 5-46, D.Malcolm 5-50) and 108-3 (J.Kallis 52 not out). Derbyshire 178 (D.Jones 53).
At Taunton: Sussex 241 (Mushtaq Ahmed 6-70) and 6-0. Somerset 409 (G.Rose 191, R.Harden 103; P.Jarvis 5-122).
At The Oval: Surrey 115 (S.Young 4-26) and 59-3. Gloucestershire 371 (J.Russell 59; A.Tudor 6-101).
At Edgbaston: Yorkshire 233 (D.Lehmann 62, M.Vaughan 56; A.Giles 4-54, A.Donald 4-55) and 154. Warwickshire 140 (T.Penney 67; D.Gough 4-62) and 76-3.
At Fenner's: Cambridge University 280-9 declared (W.House 68, R.Jones 60, E.Smith 59; J.Brown 4-50). Northamptonshire 191-3 (R.Bailey 88 not out).
At The Parks: Worcestershire 359-2 declared (G.Hick 164 not out, P.Weston 119) and 38-0. Oxford University 281-8 declared (M.Wagh 64, R D Hudson 62)
